scope: Structural source-tree and branch inventory for the 20 repositories added to the live 112-repository owner inventory. Selected workflow/source files were inspected. This is not a full security, dependency, semantic correctness or production audit.
limitations: Main-branch tree snapshots only; no full Git history scan in this pass.
Branch counts are current API observations, not a complete branch/commit lineage audit.
Presence of tests or workflows does not prove that tests pass or that workflows execute them.
Most Timeweb research labs still need per-repository workflow execution review and independent experiment reproduction.
No credentials were read, rotated or remediated in this pass.

repositories.name: tiimeweb_synergy_exactly_once_delivery
repositories.ci_tests_review: research-ci inspected: syntax compilation and documentation checks; does not execute unit tests

The claim is transaction-scoped, not transport-level or external-API exactly-once.
